title: CTS Evangelistic Preaching · Unit 3 · Characteristics of Effective Evangelistic Preaching

blocks.es_reference: CTS Predicación Evangelística · Unidad 3
Características de la Predicación Evangelística Efectiva
Idioma:
Vía:
Objetivo de Aprendizaje

blocks.en: After studying this unit you will be able to identify and explain the key characteristics that make evangelistic preaching effective, and to apply those characteristics when you prepare and deliver your own evangelistic messages.
blocks.es_reference: Después de estudiar esta unidad podrá identificar y explicar las características clave que hacen efectiva la predicación evangelística, y aplicar esas características cuando prepare y entregue sus propios mensajes evangelísticos.
¿Qué Hace Efectiva la Predicación Evangelística?

blocks.en: In Unit 8 of WiseSpeak we learned that evangelistic preaching has one central purpose: to bring men and women to Christ. But not every sermon that mentions the gospel actually moves people toward conversion. Certain characteristics consistently appear in the most effective evangelistic preaching. These traits flow directly from the biblical foundations we studied in Unit 2 and from the keyword approach we reviewed there. When they are present, the Holy Spirit uses the message to produce lasting fruit.
blocks.es_reference: En la Unidad 8 de WiseSpeak aprendimos que la predicación evangelística tiene un propósito central: llevar a hombres y mujeres a Cristo. Pero no todo sermón que menciona el evangelio mueve realmente a las personas hacia la conversión. Ciertas características aparecen de manera consistente en la predicación evangelística más efectiva. Estos rasgos fluyen directamente de los fundamentos bíblicos que estudiamos en la Unidad 2 y del enfoque de la palabra clave que repasamos allí. Cuando están presentes, el Espíritu Santo usa el mensaje para producir fruto duradero.

blocks.en: The most effective evangelistic preaching always includes seven characteristics.
blocks.es_reference: La predicación evangelística más efectiva siempre incluye siete características.
Las Siete Características

blocks.en: Clear gospel presentation. The sermon presents the gospel of Jesus Christ with unmistakable clarity. It explains who Jesus is, what He did on the cross, and what He offers to the sinner. There is no vague religious language. The message answers the question, "What must I do to be saved?" in plain, direct terms.
blocks.es_reference: Presentación clara del evangelio. El sermón presenta el evangelio de Jesucristo con claridad inconfundible. Explica quién es Jesús, qué hizo en la cruz y qué ofrece al pecador. No hay lenguaje religioso vago. El mensaje responde a la pregunta "¿Qué debo hacer para ser salvo?" en términos sencillos y directos.

blocks.en: Urgent call to decision. Effective evangelistic preaching does not leave the listener comfortable. It presses for an immediate response. The preacher makes it clear that today is the day of salvation and that delay is dangerous. This urgency comes from the biblical truth: "Now is the accepted time" (2 Corinthians 6:2, NKJV).
blocks.es_reference: Llamado urgente a la decisión. La predicación evangelística efectiva no deja al oyente cómodo. Presiona por una respuesta inmediata. El predicador deja claro que hoy es el día de salvación y que la demora es peligrosa. Esta urgencia proviene de la verdad bíblica: "He aquí ahora el tiempo aceptable" (2 Corintios 6:2, RVG).

blocks.en: Biblical authority. Every point rests solidly on Scripture. The preacher does not rely on personal stories or clever illustrations as the main foundation. The Bible itself is the authority. When the keyword approach is used, each point is supported by its own clear text so the listener knows the message comes from God, not from the preacher.
blocks.es_reference: Autoridad bíblica. Cada punto descansa sólidamente en las Escrituras. El predicador no se basa en historias personales ni en ilustraciones ingeniosas como fundamento principal. La Biblia misma es la autoridad. Cuando se usa el enfoque de la palabra clave, cada punto está apoyado por su propio texto claro para que el oyente sepa que el mensaje proviene de Dios, no del predicador.

blocks.en: Personal application. The sermon speaks directly to the heart of the listener. It does not stay in the third person. It uses "you" language so that every unsaved person feels the message is addressed to him or her personally. The points move from biblical truth to personal need.
blocks.es_reference: Aplicación personal. El sermón habla directamente al corazón del oyente. No se queda en tercera persona. Usa el lenguaje de "tú" para que cada persona no salva sienta que el mensaje está dirigido a él o a ella personalmente. Los puntos pasan de la verdad bíblica a la necesidad personal.

blocks.en: Dependence on the Holy Spirit. The preacher knows that only the Holy Spirit can convict of sin and draw people to Christ. The sermon is bathed in prayer before it is preached, and the preacher preaches with full dependence on the Spirit rather than on his own skill or eloquence.
blocks.es_reference: Dependencia del Espíritu Santo. El predicador sabe que solo el Espíritu Santo puede convencer de pecado y atraer a las personas a Cristo. El sermón está bañado en oración antes de predicarse, y el predicador predica con total dependencia del Espíritu en lugar de su propia habilidad o elocuencia.

blocks.en: Simplicity of language. The message uses words that ordinary people can understand. Theological terms are explained or avoided when possible. The goal is not to impress the listener with knowledge but to help the listener meet God.
blocks.es_reference: Simplicidad de lenguaje. El mensaje usa palabras que la gente común puede entender. Los términos teológicos se explican o se evitan cuando es posible. El objetivo no es impresionar al oyente con conocimiento sino ayudar al oyente a encontrarse con Dios.

blocks.en: Passionate delivery. The preacher preaches with genuine passion because he believes the message with all his heart. The tone, the urgency, and the emotion flow from a heart that is broken for the lost. This passion is contagious and helps the listener feel the weight of the decision being presented.
blocks.es_reference: Entrega apasionada. El predicador predica con pasión genuina porque cree el mensaje con todo su corazón. El tono, la urgencia y la emoción fluyen de un corazón quebrantado por los perdidos. Esta pasión es contagiosa y ayuda al oyente a sentir el peso de la decisión que se presenta.

blocks.en: These seven characteristics work together. When they are present, the evangelistic sermon becomes a powerful tool in the hand of God.
blocks.es_reference: Estas siete características trabajan juntas. Cuando están presentes, el sermón evangelístico se convierte en una herramienta poderosa en la mano de Dios.

blocks.en: Applying the Keyword Approach to the Characteristics
blocks.es_reference: Aplicando el Enfoque de la Palabra Clave a las Características

blocks.en: We can use the keyword method from the first seven units of WiseSpeak to organize a sermon on these traits. The probing question is, "What makes evangelistic preaching effective?" The keyword is "characteristics" (a plural noun). The subject becomes "Seven Characteristics of Effective Evangelistic Preaching." The objective is, "To lead every listener to recognize these characteristics and begin applying them in their own preaching."
blocks.es_reference: Podemos usar el método de la palabra clave de las primeras siete unidades de WiseSpeak para organizar un sermón sobre estos rasgos. La pregunta de sondeo es: "¿Qué hace efectiva la predicación evangelística?" La palabra clave es "características" (un sustantivo plural). El tema se convierte en "Siete Características de la Predicación Evangelística Efectiva". El objetivo es: "Llevar a cada oyente a reconocer estas características y comenzar a aplicarlas en su propia predicación".

blocks.en: Subject: Seven Characteristics of Effective Evangelistic Preaching · Keyword: characteristics
blocks.es_reference: Tema: Siete Características de la Predicación Evangelística Efectiva · Palabra clave: características

blocks.en: Each point is the singular form of the plural keyword "characteristics":
blocks.es_reference: Cada punto es la forma singular de la palabra clave plural "características":
Presentación clara del evangelio
Llamado urgente a la decisión
Autoridad bíblica
Aplicación personal
Dependencia del Espíritu Santo
Simplicidad de lenguaje
Entrega apasionada

blocks.en: Each point can be supported by its own Scripture text and practical explanation so the sermon remains unified and easy to follow. The keyword holds the entire sermon together. When one verse does not contain every point, we use a topical outline with supporting texts from different passages. The points stay clean and direct.
blocks.es_reference: Cada punto puede estar apoyado por su propio texto de las Escrituras y explicación práctica para que el sermón permanezca unificado y fácil de seguir. La palabra clave mantiene unido el sermón. Cuando un solo versículo no es suficiente, usamos un bosquejo topical con textos de apoyo de diferentes pasajes. Los puntos se mantienen limpios y directos.
Ejemplos Prácticos de WiseSpeak Unidad 8

blocks.en: WiseSpeak Unit 8 already shows several of these characteristics in action. The planning methods — words, questions, interviews, and texts — all aim at clear gospel presentation. The section on the invitation shows the urgent call to decision. The emphasis on the gospel message itself demonstrates biblical authority and personal application. Studying Unit 8 alongside these characteristics shows how the foundations of the first seven units are lived out in real evangelistic preaching.
blocks.es_reference: La Unidad 8 de WiseSpeak ya nos muestra varias de estas características en acción. Los métodos de planificación — palabras, preguntas, entrevistas y textos — apuntan todos a una presentación clara del evangelio. La sección sobre la invitación muestra el llamado urgente a la decisión. El énfasis en el mensaje del evangelio mismo demuestra autoridad bíblica y aplicación personal. Estudiar la Unidad 8 junto con estas características muestra cómo los fundamentos de las primeras siete unidades se viven en la predicación evangelística real.
Por Qué Importan Estas Características Hoy

blocks.en: In our modern world many people have short attention spans and are bombarded with competing messages. Clear gospel presentation cuts through the noise. An urgent call to decision counters the tendency to delay. Biblical authority gives the sermon a weight that human opinions cannot provide. Personal application makes the truth hit home. Dependence on the Holy Spirit reminds us that the results are not up to us. Simplicity of language reaches people who have never been to church. Passionate delivery shows that the preacher actually believes what he is saying.
blocks.es_reference: En nuestro mundo moderno muchas personas tienen períodos de atención cortos y están bombardeadas con mensajes competidores. La presentación clara del evangelio corta el ruido. Un llamado urgente a la decisión contrarresta la tendencia a demorar. La autoridad bíblica da al sermón un peso que las opiniones humanas no pueden proporcionar. La aplicación personal hace que la verdad llegue al corazón. La dependencia del Espíritu Santo nos recuerda que los resultados no dependen de nosotros. La simplicidad de lenguaje alcanza a personas que nunca han ido a la iglesia. La entrega apasionada muestra que el predicador realmente cree lo que está diciendo.

blocks.en: When these characteristics are missing, even a sermon that mentions Jesus can leave people unchanged. When they are present, God can use the message to bring genuine conversion.
blocks.es_reference: Cuando faltan estas características, incluso un sermón que menciona a Jesús puede dejar a las personas sin cambio. Cuando están presentes, Dios puede usar el mensaje para traer una conversión genuina.

mc.stem: What is the central purpose of evangelistic preaching, as restated from Unit 8 of WiseSpeak?
options: To deepen the doctrinal knowledge of mature believers
To bring men and women to Christ
To rebuke the worldliness of the surrounding culture
To provide ethical guidance for daily living

mc.stem: How many characteristics of effective evangelistic preaching does this unit identify?
options: Three
Five
Seven
Ten

mc.stem: The first characteristic of effective evangelistic preaching is:
options: Clear gospel presentation
Passionate delivery
Simplicity of language
Biblical authority

mc.stem: Which Scripture is cited as the basis for the urgent call to decision?
options: Romans 10:9
John 3:16
Acts 16:31
2 Corinthians 6:2

mc.stem: In effective evangelistic preaching, biblical authority means:
options: The preacher must quote the original Greek and Hebrew in every sermon
Every point rests solidly on Scripture rather than on personal stories or clever illustrations
Only ordained ministers may preach the gospel publicly
The preacher cites historical creeds in every sermon

mc.stem: Personal application is described as using:
options: Third-person illustrations from church history
Scientific language familiar to academics
Anonymous testimonies from former members
'You' language so each unsaved listener feels personally addressed

mc.stem: 'Dependence on the Holy Spirit' means the preacher:
options: Bathes the sermon in prayer and relies on the Spirit rather than on his own skill or eloquence
Refuses to study so the Spirit alone supplies the words
Asks the congregation to pray instead of praying himself
Prepares a sermon only when he has had a special vision

mc.stem: 'Simplicity of language' aims at:
options: Reducing every sermon to fewer than five minutes
Removing all biblical references for non-believers
Helping ordinary people understand, not impressing the listener with knowledge
Avoiding any mention of sin or judgment

mc.stem: Passionate delivery flows from:
options: Loud shouting and dramatic gestures rehearsed in advance
A heart broken for the lost and full belief in the message preached
Imitation of famous evangelists the preacher has watched
The natural temperament of an outgoing personality

mc.stem: 'Clear gospel presentation' answers what listener question?
options: Why did God create the world?
How can I become a better citizen?
When will Christ return in glory?
What must I do to be saved?

mc.stem: The probing question used in this unit to organize the sermon on these traits is:
options: What makes evangelistic preaching effective?
Who is the greatest evangelist of all time?
Where should the next crusade be held?
When was the gospel first preached?

options: principles
marks
characteristics
virtues

options: Biblical authority
Theological complexity for the academically trained

mc.stem: When the seven characteristics are missing, even a sermon mentioning Jesus can:
options: Produce more lasting fruit than the preacher expects
Become a great evangelistic success against all odds
Substitute perfectly for the work of the Holy Spirit
Leave people unchanged

options: People have short attention spans and tend to delay important decisions
The age of revival ended in the nineteenth century
The gospel is now too well-known to require urgency

mc.stem: Biblical authority gives the sermon weight that:
options: Personal stories supply just as effectively
Modern psychology can equally provide
Human opinions cannot provide
Cultural relevance always supersedes

mc.stem: Dependence on the Holy Spirit reminds us that:
options: Skillful eloquence is the chief factor in conversion
The results of evangelism are not up to us
The Spirit works only through ordained clergy
Prayer is optional once the sermon is well prepared

A proper noun

fill.prompt: The most effective evangelistic preaching always includes ____ characteristics.

The urgent call to decision comes from the biblical truth: "Now is the ____ time" (2 Corinthians 6:2).
Under biblical authority, the preacher does not rely on personal stories or on clever ____ (the pictures and examples a preacher uses to light up a point) as the main foundation.
Personal application does not stay in the third person; it uses "____" language so that every unsaved person feels addressed personally.
The preacher knows that only the Holy Spirit can convict of ____ and draw people to Christ.
Depending on the Holy Spirit, the preacher makes sure the sermon is bathed in ____ before it is preached.
For simplicity of language, theological terms are explained or ____ when possible.
The passion of a preacher whose heart is broken for the lost is ____: it spreads from the preacher to the listener and helps the listener feel the weight of the decision.
In our modern world, an urgent call to decision counters the tendency to ____.

sa.prompt: List the seven characteristics of effective evangelistic preaching.
sa.model: The seven characteristics are: a clear gospel presentation, an urgent call to decision, biblical authority, personal application, dependence on the Holy Spirit, simplicity of language, and passionate delivery.

sa.prompt: Which Scripture is cited as the foundation for the urgent call to decision, and what does it say?
sa.model: The foundation cited for the urgent call to decision is 2 Corinthians 6:2 - 'now is the accepted time; now is the day of salvation.' It teaches that the time to respond to the gospel is today, not some later day.

sa.prompt: What does 'biblical authority' require of the preacher, and what does it not allow him to rely on?
sa.model: Biblical authority requires the preacher to ground the message in Scripture so the authority is God's Word, not his own opinions. It does not allow him to rely on personal stories or clever illustrations as the real basis of the sermon.

sa.prompt: What kind of language does 'personal application' call for, and why?
sa.model: Personal application calls for direct, second-person language - speaking to 'you' - so the truth is addressed personally to each listener's heart rather than left as a general statement about people in the abstract.

sa.prompt: What does 'dependence on the Holy Spirit' practically require of the preacher?
sa.model: Dependence on the Holy Spirit practically requires the preacher to pray and rely on the Spirit to convict hearts and draw sinners, rather than trusting his own eloquence or skill to produce conversion.

sa.prompt: Why does the unit insist on simplicity of language?
sa.model: The unit insists on simplicity of language so ordinary people can understand the message. The goal is not to impress with theological terms but to explain the gospel plainly enough that anyone present can grasp it and respond.

sa.prompt: From where does passionate delivery flow, and what does it accomplish in the listener?
sa.model: Passionate delivery flows from the preacher's own heart - a heart broken for the lost that truly believes the message. That passion is contagious; it presses the weight of the truth on the listener and moves him toward decision.

sa.prompt: State the probing question, keyword, and subject of the sample sermon Wayne builds in this unit.
sa.model: In the sample sermon Wayne builds, the probing question is 'What makes evangelistic preaching effective?', the keyword is 'characteristics,' and the subject is 'Seven Characteristics of Effective Evangelistic Preaching,' with each point a singular of that keyword.

sa.prompt: Why does this unit say the urgent call to decision is especially important in our modern world?
sa.model: The urgent call to decision is especially important today because modern listeners have short attention spans, face many competing messages, and tend to delay; pressing for a decision now counters that drift and calls for an immediate response.

sa.prompt: Explain what tends to happen to a sermon that mentions Jesus but lacks these seven characteristics, and why.
sa.model: A sermon that mentions Jesus but lacks these seven characteristics tends to leave the listener unchanged and unmoved. Without clarity, urgency, authority, personal application, the Spirit, simplicity, and passion, it falls short of producing the decision and fruit evangelistic preaching aims for.
